string.name: user_agreement_content
string.value: Welcome. By using this app you agree to: 1) The app is for personal goal and time management; data is stored locally by default. 2) With cloud sync enabled, goals and tasks are stored on Huawei Cloud via encrypted channels, accessible only to your account. 3) The AI breakdown feature sends your goal description to a large-model service to generate plans and for no other purpose. 4) We do not collect sensitive permissions such as contacts or location. For questions, contact us via in-app feedback.

string.name: privacy_content
string.value:
Thank you for using Momentum!

1. We only collect necessary account info (nickname, avatar) for login and display.
2. Your goal and task data is stored locally and will not be uploaded (cloud sync is opt-in).
3. We will not share your information with third parties.
4. You can delete all data anytime in Settings.

For questions, contact the developer.
